toolingCorrections: The first draft of the naming table used fabricated positional keys (key1..key306) and, worse, invented names for entries that had never been read from the brief (everything past entry 80). The whole table was thrown away. The table now keys rows by the brief's own key (value396@2621, arg151@2807, ...) and only names entries that were actually dumped; the assembler's key-set check against the brief is exactly the guard for this. Lesson: never write a name for an entry whose declaration and references have not been read.

ownerLimited: the presence sensor animation: orbitOffsetX / orbitOffsetY feed the --hb-presence-orbit-* custom properties and a 0.707 (cos 45) diagonal term; haloScale / haloScaleX / haloScaleY, haloRotation, haloOpacity and personScale / personRotation / personOpacity are separate families, and the six body parts are personHeadElement / personTorsoElement / personLeftArmElement / personRightArmElement / personLeftLegElement / personRightLegElement

the air conditioner badge: badgeSizePx / symbolSizePx / iconBadgeElement / configuredIconName / resolvedIconName / resolvedIconUrl, where configured is what the properties ask for and resolved is what the icon set actually answers

the camera frame: viewportPixelWidth / viewportPixelHeight / frameStrokeWidth / frameStrokeInset / frameInnerWidth / frameInnerHeight / cornerRadiusRatio / frameCornerRadius / cameraFrameOpacity / cameraFrameColor / cameraFrameId / cameraFrameSvgElement / cameraFrameDefsElement / cameraFrameGradientElement, all prefixed so they never collide with the title-button frame family from chunk 2

the camera snapshot stream: cameraSourceByEntityId / pendingSourceRequestByEntityId (both Maps), resolveCameraStreamSource, cachedSourceRecord / pendingSourceRequest / sourceRequestPromise, CAMERA_SOURCE_CACHE_TTL_MS / CAMERA_MAX_SOURCES, cameraStreamUrl / cameraHlsResponse / cameraHlsPayload

the camera transport state machine: cameraVideoElement + fallbackImageElement, isTransportDisposed / isLegacyTransport / hasRequestedFallbackImage / hasVideoStarted / isPageHidden flags, transportGeneration plus per-call fallbackGeneration / legacyGeneration / playbackGeneration / transportGenerationSnapshot, and the four timers hlsManifestTimerId / hlsStartTimerId / legacyProbeTimerId / refreshTimerId

the vacuum map image: vacuumMapImageLoader plus syncVacuumMapImage / handleMapVisibilityChange, film missingEntityPlaceholderElement (no entity bound) against unavailableMapPlaceholderElement (entity bound, map not ready)

the time / date / weather trio each keep their own properties and element names: timeProperties / timeFontSize / timeComponentElement / timeValueElement / timePeriodElement, dateProperties / datePrimaryElement / lunarElement / primaryFontSize / lunarFontSize, weatherProperties / weatherIconSlug / weatherConditionLabel / temperatureValue / temperatureUnit / weatherDetailParts

the line chart and its details page share concepts but must stay unique per file, so the chart uses stateValueElement / stateUnitElement / syncedStateValue / chartPathDefinition / chartDefsElement / chartHoverOverlayElement while the details page uses detailsStateValue / detailsUnit / detailsGradientId / detailsDefsElement / detailsThresholdEntries

newConcepts: the presence sensor presentation: an orbiting person figure drawn from six body-part spans plus a halo whose scale/rotation/opacity come from animationStrength, an orbit duration and a motion timeout that clears the occupied state

the camera snapshot renderer: a cache keyed by entity id with a 30s TTL and at most 4 warm sources, sequential snapshot refresh with an abort controller, a hidden-document pause and a resume deferred through a zero-delay timer

the camera transport ladder: HLS first (window.Hls with lowLatencyMode) then legacy MJPEG through /api/camera_proxy_stream/, each step guarded by a generation counter and a page-hidden flag, with a fallback snapshot image at /api/camera_proxy/<entity>?hb=<now> and a 7s probe timer for the legacy stream
the vacuum map renderer: mounts a vacuumMapImageLoader, syncs it from the studio through a hbSyncVacuumMap hook, and distinguishes an unbound entity from an unready map with two placeholders

the time / date / weather controls: a <time> element refreshed every 250ms when showSeconds is set, a date block with an optional lunar line refreshed every 30s, and a weather icon (meteocon) plus temperature and a joined humidity/condition detail line

the line chart renderer: lineChartGeometry over a buildHistorySeries result, a smoothed path (smoothChartPath), threshold stops sorted by value, and an SVG gradient keyed by lineChartGradientId; the hover overlay is created by createHoverLineChart and cleaned up through the render environment
the exported renderLineChartDetails page: a compact mode that widens the view and removes the vertical offset, with its own geometry, gradient and threshold stop family
